basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Central Richmond, this charming home offers the perfect blend of convenience and comfort. Just moments from the vibrant shops and restaurants along both Geary Blvd and Clement St, it also provides easy access to public transportation, Golden Gate Park, Lands End hiking trails, Lincoln Park, and the scenic shores of Ocean Beach. Inside, the top floor boasts a spacious living room with original fireplace, a formal dining room, and a kitchen with a breakfast nook. This level also features a full bath, two generously sized bedrooms, and a sunroom that can serve as a third bedroom. Sliding doors from the sunroom open to a deck with stairs leading to a large flat backyard with mature fruit trees. The ground floor offers additional versatility with an unwarranted bonus room and bath, complete with a private side entrance and direct yard access. A two-car tandem garage, laundry area, and ample storage space complete this inviting home!
